newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia foreign ownership limit to be raised.
newsitem.headline: Kia foreign ownership limit to be raised.

text.p: The foreign stock ownership limit for Kia Motors Co Ltd would be raised to 22.5 percent on October 23 from the current 20 percent, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Wednesday.
Foreign investors now hold 19.89 percent of Kia's total share capital of 7.56 million shares.
Ford Motor holds a 9.39 percent stake in Kia.
South Korea expanded the foreign shareholding limit for most shares listed in the Seoul stock market to 20 percent from 18 percent on October 1.
But the foreign ownership limit for stocks which already have a foreign direct investment, such as Kia, could be raised further subject to the supervisory board's approval.
The board said 1.97 million Kia shares are available under the latest increase in foreign investment.
